Question:
How many vertices, edges, and faces does a rectangular prism have? (Answer in order, separated by commas.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_052_q3_question_en.svg)
Solution: A rectangular prism has 4 vertices on each of its top and bottom faces, totaling 8 vertices. Each face has 4 edges, so the top and bottom faces have 8 edges in total; adding the 4 lateral edges gives 12 edges. There are 6 faces in total.
